How to prevent complications of Diabetes mellitus?\u0026nbsp;\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EA healthy lifestyle is the key to prevent complications.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E- Follow a healthy eating plan\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E- physical activity for atleast 150min a week.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E- Get a regular HbA1C and aim to stay in your targets.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E- Aim to keep blood pressure 140\/90mm Hg\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E- stop smoking or don't start\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E- lose weight if you are obese.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E- take medicines as indicated.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E- make regular appointments with health care team.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EReference:\u0026nbsp;\u003Ca He was presented to hospital with swelling over left occipital region and seizure like activity there was loss of consciousness for 1hr not associated with ear or nose bleeding, vomiting .where they done\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ECT brain and was told to be normal.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EAnd from then he has been having episodes of occipital and parietal region headache , giddiness,palpitations, sweating, and left upper quadrant abdominal pain .\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHe discontinued intermediate 1st yr 10yrs back due to family health problems and since then he is helping his father in their printing shop .
